      - name: Generate artifact attestation

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Build and push image
        run: |
          # Build the Docker image
          docker build -t my-image .
          # Push the image to Amazon ECR
          aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login -u AWS --password-stdin

      - name: Update task definition
        run: |
          # Update the task definition with the new image ID
          aws ecs update-task-definition --task-definition my-task-definition --container-overrides "{\"name\":\"my-container\",\"image\":\"my-image\"}"

      - name: Deploy to Amazon ECS
        run: |
          # Deploy the task definition to Amazon ECS
          aws ecs run-task --cluster my-cluster --task-definition my-task-definition

  download-artifact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: pull-request-number

      - name: Unzip artifact
        run: unzip pull-request-number.zip

      - name: Comment on pull request
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = require('fs').readFileSync('pull-request-number.txt', 'utf8').trim();
            const { data: pullRequest } = await github.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: prNumber
            });
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: 'Artifact processed and PR commented.'
            })
